done_when: forge read rewrites every path under the checkout in the reader's output to a repo-root path (/docs/..., which GitHub resolves from the repo root), before writing the notes, for both readers; a test feeds a stub reader an absolute path and finds only the repo-root path in the notes

dismissals.because: src/forge/story.py:445 the machine-specific checkout prefix is removed for every path in either separator form, which is this fix's purpose; a backslash left after a space inside a quoted Windows path is repo-relative, leaks nothing, and is an edge case not worth more parsing

findings.body: The suffix regex stops at whitespace, so Windows separators after a space remain unchanged. For checkout `C:\work\repo`, the quoted citation `"C:\work\repo\docs\design notes\a.md"` becomes `"/docs/design notes\a.md"`, rather than `"/docs/design notes/a.md"`. Windows is supported by `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:22`. Removing the machine-specific prefix alone does not satisfy the required repo-root path conversion. Normalize the complete cited path and extend the stub-reader test with a directory containing spaces.
findings.title: Not done: forge read rewrites every path under the checkout in the reader's output to a repo-root path (/docs/..., which GitHub resolves من?

why: forge read writes the cold reader's output as is, and the Codex reader cites files by this machine's absolute path, so the committed read notes carry /Users/... paths that are wrong for everyone else
